item.title: EplayerX 1.2.55
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改进与 Trakt 的播放进度同步。从「继续观看」移除剧集时，会同步更新 Trakt 的观看状态。 - 当首页窗口失去焦点或被播放器遮挡时，暂停动态服务器图标，减少后台资源占用。 - 改进画面关键词跳过的识别效率，减少播放期间重复加载文字识别资源。 - 减少播放器重复检查缓冲区和扫描待翻译字幕的开销，并修复预告片结束时字幕清理的问题。 - 改进旧版下载任务的迁移，保留已有下载记录。会员状态现在使用经过验证的购买信息。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved playback progress sync with Trakt. Removing a show from Continue Watching now updates its viewing status on Trakt. - Animated server icons pause when the Home window loses focus or is covered by the player, reducing background resource use. - Improved screen-keyword skipping by reducing repeated loading of text-recognition resources during playback. - Reduced overhead from repeated playback buffer checks and subtitle translation lookahead, and fixed caption cleanup when trailers end. - Improved migration of existing download tasks to preserve download records. Membership status now uses verified purchase information.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
